lines: Two men climbed into a king's prayer room... a test.
One said: My brother has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one.
Prophet Dawud, alayhis salaam, knew it was a test. He asked forgiveness of his Lord, and fell down bowing.
A king. Bowing in a moment.
Turn back to Allah today, before the moment passes. Full movie below.

beats.text: Two men climbed into a king's prayer room… a test.
beats.ur: دو آدمی بادشاہ کے عبادت خانے میں آئے… یہ ایک آزمائش تھی
ننانوے دنبیاں… اور میرے پاس ایک

beats.en: And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]

beats.text: A king. Bowing in a moment.
beats.ur: ایک بادشاہ… ایک لمحے میں سجدے میں

beats.text: Turn back to Allah today, before the moment passes.
beats.ur: آج ہی اللہ کی طرف لوٹ آئیں، اس سے پہلے کہ لمحہ گزر جائے

scenes.style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. Ancient Jerusalem, the time of the kings of Bani Israil. Absolutely no king, no prophet, no holy figure; no person close up; ordinary people only, small and from behind.

scenes.s1: A tall stone wall of an ancient palace at dusk with a high arched window lit from inside, a rope ladder hanging on the wall, mysterious. No people.
scenes.s2: An empty quiet stone prayer chamber with a reading stand, oil lamps and a woven prayer rug, soft golden light through a high window. No people.
scenes.s3: A large flock of ninety-nine sheep on a green hillside and, apart on the other side of a low stone wall, one single lamb alone, morning light. No people.
scenes.s4: Close view of an empty prayer rug on a stone floor in warm lamplight, an oil lamp beside it, soft dust in the air, peaceful. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no human figures, no silhouettes anywhere in the image.
scenes.s5: Golden sunrise over the hills and stone walls of ancient Jerusalem, birds flying, bright and hopeful. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no human figures, no silhouettes anywhere in the image.
